content: गल्लः The cheek; especially, the part of the cheek near the corners of the mouth; <ls>Pt. 1. 123</ls>. (Rhetoricians consider this word to be ग्राम्य or vulgar; <ab>cf.</ab> the instance given in <ls>K. P. 7</ls>:-- ताम्बूलभृतगल्लोऽयं भल्लं जल्पति मानुषः; but <ab>cf.</ab> Bhavabhūtiʼs use:-- पातालप्रतिमल्लगल्लविवरप्रक्षिप्तसप्तार्णवम् <ls>Māl. 5. 22</ls>).
